projects.name: Crane Clean Energy Center
projects.quote: The restart is supported by a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Microsoft to purchase the output generated from the renewed plant.

projects.name: Freestone Energy Center data center
projects.quote: Our subsidiary Calpine LLC signed a new 380-megawatt (MW) agreement with Dallas-based CyrusOne, a leading global data center developer and operator, to connect and serve a new data center adjacent to the Freestone Energy Center, in Freestone County, Texas.

projects.name: Freestone Energy Center data center Phase 2
projects.quote: Calpine has also entered into an exclusive agreement to provide power, grid connectivity and site infrastructure for Phase 2, which will be an additional 380 MW.

projects.name: Thad Hill Energy Center
projects.quote: These agreements are in addition to the 400 MW agreements announced in the second half of last year between Calpine and CyrusOne for the Thad Hill Energy Center in Bosque County, Texas.

projects.name: Clinton and Dresden license renewal
projects.quote: We are the nation’s largest operator of clean, reliable nuclear power, and we are investing more than $370 million to relicense the plants, installing state- of-the-art upgrades to increase efficiency and ensure safety and reliability for decades to come.
